title: Max Miller stays in Ohio House race as GOP ballot deadline passes
summary: Rep. Max Miller will remain the Republican nominee for Ohio's 7th District after the GOP's deadline to replace him on the November ballot passed. The decision closes the party's opportunity to swap candidates before the general election.
content: Rep. Max Miller is set to remain the Republican nominee in Ohio’s 7th District after the window for the GOP to replace him on the November ballot closed.

title: 5 career ‘rules’ your parents taught you that are working against you, says expert—and what to do instead

content: "Well-intentioned career advice absorbed from a young age can work against you," says executive coach Melody Wilding, author of "Managing Up."

title: Ocasio-Cortez hasn't 'ruled out' running for president or Senate in 2028

title: Myspace eyes comeback as an an 'antidote' to social media fatigue — but it may be a long shot
summary: Myspace is attempting a comeback as consumers seek alternatives to mainstream social media platforms dominated by algorithmic feeds. The potential revival is driven by nostalgia for a less algorithm-driven internet era, though industry experts remain skeptical about its long-term viability.
content: "Excitement about Myspace's relaunch reflects nostalgia for a more analog time, when algorithms were less dominant in our lives," an analyst told CNBC.
